name: scenario-har
what: the scenario agent turns a browser's HAR export of the defect into a red that replays it

slice.title: An item that runs out today is missing from what runs out soon

baseline_prompt: There is a defect in this repo. An item that runs out today is missing from the list of what runs out soon: the household asks for what runs out within three days on 2026-10-21, and milk that runs out on 2026-10-21 is missing from the answer. A HAR export of the requests is at .xv/recordings/expiring-today.har. Write a failing test that reproduces this defect.
